A PN-junction germanium diode has a saturation current of 1µA for an applied forward voltage of
0.2V at 27oC. Determine the static and dynamic resistance. Also calculate the reverse saturation
current when temperature rises to 47oC.

With a neat diagram, explain the structure and operation of MOSFET. Also, sketch and explain the
ID-VGS and ID-VDS characteristics.

With the help of an appropriate circuit, input & output waveforms, explain the working of a full wave
center-tap rectifier with capacitor filter.

A full wave Bridge rectifier circuit is fed by ac mains of rms 230 V, 50 Hz supply through a
transformer having turns ratio of 10:1. If the load resistance is 1kΩ, assuming the diode resistance
to be zero, determine
(i) Average output voltage.
(ii) Average load current.
(iii) Output DC power.

In a voltage regulator using Zener diode, the output voltage V0 =5V, Input voltage
Vi= (12±3) V, RS=1kΩ, Load current IL=20mA. Find the minimum and maximum currents flowing
through the Zener diode.

Explain with a neat circuit diagram how op-amp works as differentiator and derive the expression
for output voltage.

Derive the expression for the output voltage of a non-inverting op-amp amplifier with a neat circuit
diagram. Find the output voltage for input Vin= 2sin(2π100t). Given ±Vcc =15V, RF= 10kΩ and R1=
2kΩ. Plot both input and output waveforms indicating all features in it.

A hexadecimal numbers B(16) is transmitted using a (7,4) Hamming code with even parity. During
transmission, an error occurs in the 3rd bit of the codeword. Analyse and determine what is the
received codeword, showing all steps of reasoning.

Using KMAP, Deduce the simplified Boolean expression and implement it using only NAND gates
for the following expression.

With aid of relevant circuit, truth table and timing diagram explain working of negative edge
triggered JK flip-flop.

Analyze the operation of a 4-bit Serial-In Parallel-Out (SIPO) shift register by interpreting its truth
table and deducing its logical circuit for input data sequence of 1011. Explain how data propagates
through the flip-flops with each clock pulse.

Given an FM equation VFM(t)=10cos[2π108t+5sin(2 π 15000t)], Calculate Carrier frequency.
Modulating frequency. Frequency deviation. Bandwidth using Carson's rule.

Apply your understanding of communication systems to explain its components using a labeled
block diagram.

Given Binary information 10110101 plot ASK, FSK and PSK wave forms.
-----End-----

is 1KΩ. Assume Rs = 470Ω. Draw the circuit diagram.

oscillation of the output square wave signal

i) With relevant circuit diagram and equations, explain the working of an OPAMP integrator.
ii) Given three input voltage sources V1=1V, V2= sin (wt) and V3 = cos (wt) , design a two stage
OPAMP circuit to obtain V0 = 10 + 5Sin(wt) - 5cos(wt). Assume feedback resistor to be used RF =
10KΩ.

(i) Convert (0101)2 into Gray Code.
(ii) Perform (45.75)10 - (87.75)10 subtraction using 1's complement method.

(ii) Consider a new message encrypted as "1110110" using (7,4) even parity bit Hamming code
transmitted through a noisy channel. Decode the message, assuming that there can be maximum
of one bit error in the encrypted message received.

Solve F=Σ(1,5,6,12,13,14)+d(2,4) using K-Map and implement resultant expression using only
NAND gates.

A logic system has 3 inputs and one output, the output of the system is low only when any two of
the inputs are high. Write the truth table and standard SOP. Also implement the system using basic
gates.

Draw the logic diagram of a 3-bit ripple down-counter using the positive edge-triggered T flip flops.
Plot the timing diagram for the same.

Design a 4-bit Serial-In Serial-Out (SISO) shift register using D flip-flops.
(a) Draw the logic diagram showing how the flip-flops are connected.
(b) If the input data sequence is 1101, show the contents of each flip-flop (Q₃ Q₂ Q₁ Q₀) after every
clock pulse.
(c) How many clock pulses are required for the entire data to appear at the output of the register?
Compare the operation of SR, JK, D, and T flip-flops in terms of input conditions, and invalid states.

Simplify and implement F(A, B,C)=A′ B′ C+ A B′ C′ + A B′ C using an 4:1 MUX.
